purpose: Capture official SENAMHI meteorological avisos as reproduced by INDECI/COEN, with archived bytes, SHA-256, normalised fields, validity status in America/Lima and an append-only revision history. Feeds internal human review only.

source_channels.reason: The hosts decline automated access by the agent's web tools (robots). Automated requests are not routed around that refusal. Use requires an explicit owner decision backed by SENAMHI authorisation or a documented machine-access channel.

source_channels.note: INDECI/COEN reproduces each SENAMHI aviso in a 'Boletín informativo de aviso meteorológico' and lists avisos in the daily 'Boletín informativo monitoreo de peligros y perspectivas'. Field values are taken as reproduced; SENAMHI emission time is recorded only when the bulletin states it.

cadence.idempotence: documents are keyed by SHA-256 and WordPress 'modified'; unchanged items are not downloaded again

geometry.level_b_administrative: departments as listed in the bulletin; administrative boundaries not yet attached

never: treat the download time as emission or validity
declare 'no avisos' after a failed check
mix the SENAMHI official level with an IRFEN review priority
publish to the map or to third parties
query SENAMHI hosts that decline automated access
